LESSON: DIVERSITY AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Relationships
Topic 3.5: Diversity and interpersonal skills
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Diversity and interpersonal skills, part of People and Relationships in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: how to improve one’s self- How can we demonstrate respect and appreciation of Social Cultural Diversity and Inclusion?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.
